plot.description: Master Antonio, also known as Master Cherry, stumbles upon a peculiar log while gathering firewood. His attempts to carve the log result in whimsical laughter and screams, prompting him to gift it to his neighbor, Geppetto. Despite a heated argument about the log, they reconcile and the elderly Geppetto begins to carve a puppet named Pinocchio. As Pinocchio starts to take shape, trouble brews—he shows signs of mischief by stealing Geppetto’s wig and disobeying his creator. The player must navigate the initial bonding between Master Cherry and Geppetto, exploring their workshop and uncovering hidden tools while avoiding suggesting behavior from Pinocchio that could foreshadow future disobedience. Key objectives include locating tools to aid Geppetto and choosing whether to assist or hinder Pinocchio's antics.
plot.title: The Birth of Pinocchio

plot.description: After completing his puppet, Geppetto attempts to teach Pinocchio to walk. However, the moment he succeeds, Pinocchio bolts into the street, leading to a series of comedic yet perilous events. The player must choose paths that dictate Pinocchio's fate, including being caught by the policeman or encountering the Talking Cricket who warns him of the consequences of disobedience. The aim in this chapter is to explore the town, gathering food and items while avoiding mischief that could lead to capture. Tactical choices will affect how Pinocchio interacts with villagers and whether he embraces or dismisses lessons from the Cricket.
plot.title: The Mischief of Pinocchio

plot.description: Pinocchio, driven by hunger, seeks food but instead finds misfortune. He encounters the Fairy’s lessons on obedience as he rejects the warnings of the Talking Cricket and tries to cook an egg. Following his misadventures, he finally meets his father who, moved by Pinocchio's plight, decides to reform him. The player needs to navigate through choices that determine whether Pinocchio learns from his mistakes, gathers new necessities, and communicates with various townsfolk who may offer aid or obstruct him. Successfully completing this chapter leads to a crucial transformation in Pinocchio’s character.
plot.title: The Temptation of Idleness

plot.description: As Pinocchio's journey leads him to meet the Fox and the Cat, he learns of the deceptive allure of the Land of Catchfools. Enticed by great wealth, Pinocchio must navigate clever lies and greed. The player’s choices in dealing with these tricksters will shape Pinocchio’s growth. Will he plant the coins in hopes of a bounty or learn the value of honesty? To progress, the player must choose whether to follow the Fox and Cat or heed warnings from the dearly departed Talking Cricket, balancing the risks of deception against the allure of potential rewards.
plot.title: The Cunning Fox and Cat

plot.description: Pinocchio is captivated by the puppet theater and must escape the clutches of Mangiafuoco, who intends to sacrifice him to save a lamb. This chapter sees the player maneuver Pinocchio through a maze of puppet antics, performing tasks to gain Mangiafuoco’s favor. Through clever dialogues and performance-based challenges, the player can secure Pinocchio's freedom while discovering five gold coins that lead to further adventures. Decisions made here will impact future interactions and challenges, pushing Pinocchio closer to understanding true selflessness.
plot.title: The Trials of the Puppet Master

plot.description: Temptation strikes again when Pinocchio meets Lamp-Wick and feels drawn to the Land of Toys. The player navigates a series of social interactions and moral dilemmas that culminate in Pinocchio’s ultimate choice to abandon education for indulgence. As they arrive, the whimsical charms of this land quickly fade, revealing the harsh reality of their choices through physical transformations. The goal is to gather information and make pivotal choices that either lead Pinocchio to realize the consequences of his path or further embolden his mischief.
plot.title: The Snare of the Land of Toys

plot.description: Pinocchio's fate darkens as he transforms into a donkey, forced to perform tricks for a circus. Players face decision-making through tough trials that challenge their perseverance and Pinocchio's integrity. During these hardships, the player steers Pinocchio toward moments of reflection and potential redemption. They must navigate through physical obstacles while maintaining his dignity against adversity, setting the stage for deeper personal growth.
plot.title: Into the Depths of Despair

plot.description: In a climactic moment, Pinocchio finds himself swallowed by a shark, where he discovers Geppetto trapped inside. Together, they devise a plan to escape, symbolizing the reunion of love and hope. The player charts strategic actions that focus on teamwork, as they guide Pinocchio and Geppetto through dangers in their escape from the shark's belly. Completing this chapter reflects on themes of family, sacrifice, and commitment, ultimately setting Pinocchio on a path toward becoming a real boy.
plot.title: The Reunion and Redemption

plot.description: Having escaped and returned to the village, Pinocchio learns of the consequences of his past actions and how to truly give back to those he wronged. As he sets out to right his wrongs and revisit the Fairy, the player navigates through social interactions, helping others affected by his earlier misadventures. This chapter is one of moral choices and character rebuilding as Pinocchio learns the true essence of compassion. Completing this chapter should lead to a heartwarming reunion with the Fairy.
plot.title: The Final Transformation

plot.description: With Pinocchio transformed into a real boy, he embraces a fresh start alongside Geppetto. The player engages in relationships in the village, reflecting on the journey taken. Choices made here will influence how Pinocchio integrates into society as a true boy. This chapter emphasizes the themes of acceptance, kindness, and community bonds as he and Geppetto embark on their new life, highlighting the culmination of growth and friendship.
plot.title: A New Beginning

title: The Adventures of Pinocchio
world:
In a quaint Italian village, nestled between rolling hills and lush forests, the inhabitants live simple lives centered around craftsmanship and community. The story follows the developments around Geppetto, a humble carpenter, and his mischievous puppet, Pinocchio. Magic is a subtle yet intrinsic part of this world, with talking animals, wise crickets, and benevolent fairies guiding the destinies of its characters. Within this vibrant village, themes of obedience, learning, and redemption resonate through encounters with various factions such as the kind-hearted villagers, mischievous tricksters like the Fox and Cat, and benevolent figures like the Fairy with azure hair.

The rules of this world are clear: kindness begets kindness, and every action has consequences. Those who stray from the path of innocence often find themselves ensnared in troubles, while honest and diligent souls are rewarded. Throughout the journey, various characters, both human and supernatural, challenge and guide Pinocchio, testing his resolve as he strives to become a real boy, highlighting the importance of personal growth and moral integrity in the fabric of this magical reality.
